description: A vibrant and stylish arrangement of cosmetic products set against a bold, colorful background. The scene includes a variety of makeup items such as a lipstick in a sleek metallic case, a square eyeshadow palette with four shades ranging from dark to light, and a cylindrical foundation stick with a shiny silver cap. A tall, rectangular perfume bottle with a reflective surface stands prominently, casting interesting reflections and shadows. The background features a gradient of teal and green hues, adding depth and contrast to the composition. A large, faceted crystal adds an element of luxury and elegance, reflecting light in a captivating manner.
